findings.message: All ten values put {recipient} directly before a postposition (तक, द्वारा), which requires the oblique genitive के. This PR newly routes the unnamed form ("Ben Tran’s chief of staff", nominative का) into these lines via composeChiefLabel, so every delivery line for an unnamed agent renders a visible agreement error. The named form "Aida (Ben Tran)" is correct. Suggested fix (not applied by the auditor): a delivery-scoped oblique unnamed key, e.g. ui.teamBridge.delivery.recipient_unnamed = "{person} के चीफ़ ऑफ़ स्टाफ़" (en: "{person}’s chief of staff") used by deliveryChiefLabels, then a hi re-audit.

out_of_scope_observations: Pre-existing on main, not counted: other keys that embed a chief label before a postposition (e.g. ui.teamBridge.composer.placeholder_to "{name} को/کو …") carry the same oblique-case issue for the unnamed form.
